description: Generator set control, Modbus RTU on RS485, with fault status bitmaps
source: Cummins, Modbus Register Mapping (Control), A029X159 Issue 26 (6-2020): sections 13 and 14

sources.title: Modbus Register Mapping, Control
sources.note: sections 13 (parametrics) and 14 (fault status bitmaps), registers marked PC 3.x; bits marked PCC3300 V2 only exist on that hardware

notes: Addresses are the manual's 4xxxx numbers less 40000, 1-based (40011 is holding register 11).
32-bit values have the high register first. Write both registers, high then low.
Text values the manual lists as one character per register (serial numbers, time stamps) are left out.
The manual does not give the factory serial settings: check baud rate, parity, stop bits and node address on the control.
Save Trims writes the settings to flash memory, which wears out: use it only after a change, never on a schedule.
Registers missing from older control software answer with an exception.
Not available, out of range, network failure and hardware failure readings are the highest values of each type (section 13.2), declared as sentinels.
